author: Driftlet
description_zh: 屿族小卡：倒计时 + 正向计时，同款圆环一瞥进度，悬停环内步进调时长，状态跨重载续跑
description_en: Isles mini card: countdown + count-up with the family's signature ring; hover to adjust minutes in place; state survives reloads

settings.description_zh: 倒计时 = 从设定时长倒数到零；正向计时 = 从零开始累加。切换会重置当前计时
settings.description_en: Countdown runs down from the set length; count-up accumulates from zero. Switching resets the current run

settings.description_zh: 默认 25 分钟（1–180）；倒计时就绪时悬停卡面，环内 ± 钮同样可调；进行中的倒计时不受影响，下次开始生效
settings.description_en: Default is 25 min (1–180); hover the card while the countdown is ready and use the in-ring ± buttons too; a running countdown is unaffected — applies to the next start

settings.description_zh: 倒计时结束时播放一段上行琶音
settings.description_en: Play a rising arpeggio when the countdown finishes

settings.description_zh: 倒计时结束时弹 Windows 通知中心通知——皮肤被隐藏/最小化也不会错过
settings.description_en: Pop a Windows toast when the countdown finishes — you won't miss it even with the skin hidden or minimized

settings.description_zh: 一键应用整套配色（会覆盖下方颜色项）
settings.description_en: Apply a whole color scheme at once (overrides the color settings below)

settings.description_zh: 卡面背景色；透明度滑杆让卡面半透明
settings.description_en: Card background; the opacity slider makes the card translucent

settings.description_zh: 卡面文字主色，副标自动派生深浅
settings.description_en: Main text color; captions derive their shades automatically
